jurisdiction: South Africa — FIC Act 38 of 2001, Directive 9 (crypto-asset Travel Rule); FATF (2020) Virtual Asset Red Flag Indicators; FATF Recommendations 15 & 16
source_notes: ACTIVE rulebook. Real regulatory corpus prepared by the domain team, replacing the 40-rule placeholder demo set (preserved unmodified in data/rulebook.legacy.json for diffing). Only DS-01..DS-05 are populated so far; DS-06 onward will be added once the schema (rule_type indicator/obligation, trigger_schema grammar) holds on these five. ALL rule text in the `text` field is a PROVISIONAL PARAPHRASE by the domain team, NOT verified exact regulatory wording - do not present it as authoritative without checking the cited source_ref. Demonstration/development data only.

rules.name: Rapid deposit followed by rapid trade or withdrawal
rules.text: PROVISIONAL PARAPHRASE, not exact regulatory text - to be confirmed by the domain team. A large initial deposit is made to open a new account, inconsistent with the customer's declared profile, and the customer trades or withdraws most or all of the balance within a day or two of account opening.
rules.trigger: New account AND deposit value inconsistent with stated profile AND rapid trade/withdrawal (same day or next day).
mitre_atlas: AML.CS0033 (technique ID unverified) - deepfake/liveness-bypass identity onboarding

rules.name: Structuring or high-value clustering in transaction pattern
rules.text: PROVISIONAL PARAPHRASE, not exact regulatory text - to be confirmed by the domain team. Transfers are structured into amounts just under a reporting threshold, or multiple high-value transfers are made in quick succession within a short window (e.g. 24 hours).
rules.trigger: Repeated sub-threshold transfers OR high-value transfers clustered in a short (e.g. 24-hour) window.

rules.name: Travel Rule — transmission of originator and beneficiary information
rules.text: PROVISIONAL PARAPHRASE, not exact regulatory text - to be confirmed by the domain team. An ordering CASP must transmit the originator's and beneficiary's required identifying information to the recipient CASP at or before the transfer, and must not execute the transfer if it cannot meet this requirement.
rules.trigger: OBLIGATION, encoded as its breach: fires when a qualifying transfer occurs AND the required originator/beneficiary information was not transmitted.

rules.name: Transactions with counterparties with weak or absent KYC controls
rules.text: PROVISIONAL PARAPHRASE, not exact regulatory text - to be confirmed by the domain team. Funds are sent to, or received from, a VASP with demonstrably weak or absent CDD controls, or the transfer involves an unhosted wallet. NOTE: this rule also carries an obligation aspect (Directive 9 para 8.2 imposes risk-based controls on unhosted-wallet transfers) that is encoded here only as the indicator half - see the mismatch note for this rule.
rules.trigger: Counterparty VASP has demonstrably weak/no CDD, OR transfer involves an unhosted wallet.
rules.source: FATF (2020) Virtual Assets Red Flags; FIC (2024) Directive 9

rules.name: Fan-in / fan-out accumulation to a single account
rules.text: PROVISIONAL PARAPHRASE, not exact regulatory text - to be confirmed by the domain team. Repeated transfers are made to one account from multiple senders or IP addresses within a time window, or funds accumulate from many wallets before being consolidated and moved on.
rules.trigger: Repeated transfers to one account from multiple senders/IPs within a time window, OR fan-in accumulation followed by consolidation.

rules.name: Identification or credentials shared across accounts
rules.text: PROVISIONAL PARAPHRASE, not exact regulatory text - to be confirmed by the domain team. The customer provides identification information or account credentials (e.g. a non-standard IP address, or flash cookies/device fingerprints) that are shared with, or match, another account.
rules.trigger: Customer's identification info or account credentials (non-standard IP, flash cookies/device fingerprint) are shared with another account.

rules.name: Incomplete KYC or refusal of KYC/source-of-funds requests
rules.text: PROVISIONAL PARAPHRASE, not exact regulatory text - to be confirmed by the domain team. The customer provides incomplete or insufficient KYC information, or declines to respond to requests for KYC documentation or source-of-funds inquiries.
rules.trigger: KYC information incomplete/insufficient, OR customer declines KYC document requests or source-of-funds inquiries.

rules.name: Party lacks knowledge of transaction, funds source, or counterparty relationship
rules.text: PROVISIONAL PARAPHRASE, not exact regulatory text - to be confirmed by the domain team. The sender or recipient appears to lack knowledge of, or provides inaccurate information about, the transaction, the source of funds, or the relationship with the counterparty.
rules.trigger: Sender or recipient lacks knowledge, or provides inaccurate information, about the transaction, source of funds, or counterparty relationship.

rules.name: Forged or edited identity documents at onboarding
rules.text: PROVISIONAL PARAPHRASE, not exact regulatory text - to be confirmed by the domain team. The customer provided forged documents, or edited photographs or ID documents, during onboarding.
rules.trigger: Customer provided forged documents OR edited photographs/ID documents during onboarding.

rules.name: Customer VA address linked to illegal activity on public forums
rules.text: PROVISIONAL PARAPHRASE, not exact regulatory text - to be confirmed by the domain team. The customer's virtual asset address appears on public forums associated with illegal activity.
rules.trigger: Customer's VA address appears on a public forum associated with illegal activity.

rules.name: Customer publicly known to law enforcement for prior criminal association
rules.text: PROVISIONAL PARAPHRASE, not exact regulatory text - to be confirmed by the domain team. The customer is known, via publicly available information, to law enforcement due to a previous criminal association.
rules.trigger: Customer known via publicly available information to law enforcement due to previous criminal association.

rules.name: Sender unfamiliar with VA technology or custodial wallet solutions
rules.text: PROVISIONAL PARAPHRASE, not exact regulatory text - to be confirmed by the domain team. The sender does not appear familiar with virtual asset technology or online custodial wallet solutions.
rules.trigger: Sender does not appear familiar with VA technology or online custodial wallet solutions.

rules.name: Frequent changes to identification information
rules.text: PROVISIONAL PARAPHRASE, not exact regulatory text - to be confirmed by the domain team. The customer frequently changes identification information such as email, IP address, or financial information.
rules.trigger: Customer frequently changes identification information (email, IP, or financial information).

rules.name: Illicit-activity language in VA message fields
rules.text: PROVISIONAL PARAPHRASE, not exact regulatory text - to be confirmed by the domain team. Language used in virtual asset message fields is indicative of transactions supporting illicit activity or the purchase of illicit goods.
rules.trigger: Language in VA message fields indicative of transactions supporting illicit activity or purchase of illicit goods.

rules.name: Repeated transactions with a subset of counterparties at significant profit or loss
rules.text: PROVISIONAL PARAPHRASE, not exact regulatory text - to be confirmed by the domain team. The customer repeatedly conducts transactions with a subset of individuals at a significant profit or loss.
rules.trigger: Customer repeatedly conducts transactions with a subset of individuals at significant profit or loss.

rules.name: Counterparty VA address or card linked to known illicit activity
rules.text: PROVISIONAL PARAPHRASE, not exact regulatory text - to be confirmed by the domain team. The customer transacts with virtual asset addresses or bank cards connected to known fraud, extortion, ransomware, sanctioned addresses, darknet marketplaces, or other illicit websites.
rules.trigger: Transacting with VA addresses or bank cards connected to known fraud, extortion, ransomware, sanctioned addresses, darknet marketplaces, or other illicit websites.

rules.name: Card-linked large fiat withdrawals or cash-funded card purchases of VA
rules.text: PROVISIONAL PARAPHRASE, not exact regulatory text - to be confirmed by the domain team. Credit or debit cards linked to a virtual asset wallet are used to withdraw large fiat amounts, or funds used to purchase virtual assets are sourced from cash deposits into credit cards.
rules.trigger: Use of credit/debit cards linked to a VA wallet to withdraw large fiat amounts, OR funds for purchasing VAs sourced from cash deposits into credit cards.

rules.name: Funds sourced from mixing services or wallet tumblers
rules.text: PROVISIONAL PARAPHRASE, not exact regulatory text - to be confirmed by the domain team. The customer's funds are sourced directly from third-party mixing services or wallet tumblers.
rules.trigger: Customer's funds sourced directly from third-party mixing services or wallet tumblers.

rules.name: Funds moved via unregistered exchange in either jurisdiction
rules.text: PROVISIONAL PARAPHRASE, not exact regulatory text - to be confirmed by the domain team. The customer's funds originate from, or are sent to, an exchange that is not registered in the jurisdiction where either the customer or the exchange is located.
rules.trigger: Customer's funds originate from or are sent to an exchange not registered in the jurisdiction where either the customer or exchange is located.

rules.name: Office relocation to unregulated jurisdiction or without business rationale
rules.text: PROVISIONAL PARAPHRASE, not exact regulatory text - to be confirmed by the domain team. The customer sets up or moves offices to jurisdictions with no virtual asset regulation, or opens offices where there is no clear business rationale.
rules.trigger: Customer sets up or moves offices to jurisdictions with no VA regulation, OR opens offices where there is no clear business rationale.
